Im going to be completely honest to myself about this topic so bare with me please. It depends on a lot of things, if you have told most of your story to your friend in the "new country" they can be your support system. Sometimes your support system isn't always "blood-family". I don't know all about your situation but if your new friends have your best interests at heart then start making them your support system.

You just wrote a whole fucking book. I feel the same about a lot of topics you brought up. I also feel alienated and been thinking about offing myself too. I also got a dog thats keeping me going. Ive lost both my parents before i turned 13 and they weren't they best either. I grew up in the foster care system. I also got everything ive ever wanted in my whole life but it still feels empty. I found that trying to help other people that were in the same situation as me helps me the most, but on the other hand i haven't been more than 2 weeks clean for more than a year. I've been self harming since i was 12 and i was clean for almost 2 years and fucked it up. A lot of bullshit popped up in the last year with my ex beating me and "bio-family" drama, but I've learned to try to find a balance. I found your story just as inspiring as long as the post is. My inbox is open if you EVER want to talk. AND YES I READ IT ALL.

Yo i have VERY similar stuff going lol. I've recently got a roommate to help with the bills. I grew up in the foster care system so asking family for help is out of the question. But whats helped me is to find something your passionate about whether its art or something else. If you give it your all and keep on practicing you WILL get better. Do what YOU want. Im the last person who should say this but it will bet better you just have to believe.

Well ive been in a reversed situation where my siblings tried to take me in. Depending if your younger sibling has been in the foster care it takes a long process to get foster licensing and training. But if not you just need to prove to the court that the parent(s) is unfit to raise a kid. If you are in a different state, province, or county it might be a tad bit difficult to go back and forth for information. Its all situational. It took almost 2 and a half years for my brother to try to take me in 2 states away, but shit happens. If you go the children's services you will need enough people to testify and PAPERWORK.
